name: v28-40-context-over-server
objective: v2.8 31 F20 deterministic: with scripted llama.cpp backend properties (ST's /props proxy answered in the page for a run-unique server URL that nothing listens on), a reply connection asking 98304 tokens of context against a server serving 32768 raises the player-audience context-over-server row (player copy in player view, served URL and size in Author view); lowering the context to the served size clears it, and a second scripted server that serves more than asked keeps it clear. Connection type, server URL, context size and fetch are restored. No backend, no model.

requires.why: Backend properties are scripted in the page; the reply connection points at a closed port.

steps.eval: const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); if (ctx.mainApi !== 'textgenerationwebui') throw new Error('this lane replies through ' + ctx.mainApi + '; the check needs a text completion connection'); const tc = ctx.textCompletionSettings; const stamp = Date.now().toString(36); const original = globalThis.fetch; const served = new Map([[`http://127.0.0.1:18079/so-c40-small-${stamp}`, 32768], [`http://127.0.0.1:18079/so-c40-large-${stamp}`, 131072]]); const props = []; globalThis.__c40 = { original, props, served: [...served.keys()], type: tc.type, url: tc.server_urls?.llamacpp, max: ctx.maxContext, unlocked: $('#max_context_unlocked').prop('checked'), author: globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.getSnapshot().ui?.authorView ?? false }; globalThis.fetch = function (input, init) { const url = String(typeof input === 'string' ? input : input?.url ?? input); if (url.includes('/api/backends/text-completions/props')) { let body = {}; try { body = JSON.parse(init?.body ?? '{}'); } catch {} if (served.has(body.api_server)) { props.push(body.api_server); return Promise.resolve(new Response(JSON.stringify({ default_generation_settings: { n_ctx: served.get(body.api_server) } }), { status: 200, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } })); } } return original.apply(this, arguments); }; tc.type = 'llamacpp'; tc.server_urls = { ...(tc.server_urls ?? {}), llamacpp: globalThis.__c40.served[0] }; $('#max_context_unlocked').prop('checked', true).trigger('change'); $('#max_context').val(98304).trigger('input'); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 300)); if (SillyTavern.getContext().maxContext !== 98304 || SillyTavern.getContext().getTextGenServer('llamacpp') !== globalThis.__c40.served[0]) throw new Error('connection not scripted: ' + JSON.stringify({ max: SillyTavern.getContext().maxContext, url: SillyTavern.getContext().getTextGenServer('llamacpp') })); return { before: { type: globalThis.__c40.type, max: globalThis.__c40.max }, url: globalThis.__c40.served[0] };

const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const c = globalThis.__c40; const until = Date.now() + 8000; let seen = null; while (Date.now() < until) { rt.notify(); seen = rt.getSnapshot().contextOverServer ?? null; if (seen) break; await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 200)); } if (!seen || seen.set !== 98304 || seen.served !== 32768 || seen.url !== c.served[0]) throw new Error('contextOverServer not raised: ' + JSON.stringify(seen)); if (!c.props.includes(c.served[0])) throw new Error('scripted props never read'); return seen;

const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const row = () => document.querySelector('#so-setup [data-so="setup-row"][data-check="context-over-server"]'); const until = Date.now() + 8000; while (!row() && Date.now() < until) { rt.notify(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 100)); } const r = row(); if (!r) throw new Error('row missing: ' + JSON.stringify([...document.querySelectorAll('#so-setup [data-so="setup-row"]')].map((x) => x.dataset.check))); if (r.dataset.severity !== 'degrades' || !r.textContent.includes('Long chats will stop getting replies: lower the context size.') || r.querySelector('[data-so="setup-detail"]')) throw new Error('player row wrong: ' + r.textContent); return { player: r.textContent.trim() };

const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const c = globalThis.__c40; const row = () => document.querySelector('#so-setup [data-so="setup-row"][data-check="context-over-server"]'); const until = Date.now() + 8000; while (!(row()?.querySelector('[data-so="setup-detail"]')) && Date.now() < until) { rt.notify(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 100)); } const r = row(); const detail = r?.querySelector('[data-so="setup-detail"]')?.textContent ?? ''; if (!r || !r.textContent.includes('Replies stop past 32768 tokens: the connection asks for 98304.') || !detail.includes(c.served[0] + ' serves 32768.')) throw new Error('author row wrong: ' + (r?.textContent ?? 'none')); return { author: r.textContent.trim() };

const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; $('#max_context').val(32768).trigger('input'); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 300)); const row = () => document.querySelector('#so-setup [data-so="setup-row"][data-check="context-over-server"]'); const until = Date.now() + 8000; while ((rt.getSnapshot().contextOverServer || row()) && Date.now() < until) { rt.notify(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 100)); } if (rt.getSnapshot().contextOverServer || row()) throw new Error('not cleared at the served size: ' + JSON.stringify(rt.getSnapshot().contextOverServer)); return { cleared: true, maxContext: SillyTavern.getContext().maxContext };

const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const c = globalThis.__c40; $('#max_context').val(98304).trigger('input'); SillyTavern.getContext().textCompletionSettings.server_urls.llamacpp = c.served[1]; await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 300)); const until = Date.now() + 8000; while (!c.props.includes(c.served[1]) && Date.now() < until) { rt.notify(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 200)); } await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 300)); rt.notify(); const seen = rt.getSnapshot().contextOverServer ?? null; const row = document.querySelector('#so-setup [data-so="setup-row"][data-check="context-over-server"]'); if (!c.props.includes(c.served[1])) throw new Error('second scripted server never read'); if (seen || row) throw new Error('a server serving more than asked raised the row: ' + JSON.stringify(seen)); return { largeServer: c.served[1], cleared: true, propsReads: c.props.length };

const c = globalThis.__c40; const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); globalThis.fetch = c.original; ctx.textCompletionSettings.type = c.type; ctx.textCompletionSettings.server_urls.llamacpp = c.url; $('#max_context').val(c.max).trigger('input'); $('#max_context_unlocked').prop('checked', c.unlocked).trigger('change'); $('#max_context').val(c.max).trigger('input'); globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.setUiSettings({ authorView: c.author }); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 300)); const after = SillyTavern.getContext(); if (after.maxContext !== c.max || after.textCompletionSettings.type !== c.type || after.textCompletionSettings.server_urls.llamacpp !== c.url) throw new Error('connection not restored: ' + JSON.stringify({ max: after.maxContext, type: after.textCompletionSettings.type })); delete globalThis.storyOrchestratorDebugExtractionResponse; return { restored: true, max: after.maxContext };

const c = globalThis.__c40; if (c) { const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); if (globalThis.fetch !== c.original) globalThis.fetch = c.original; ctx.textCompletionSettings.type = c.type; ctx.textCompletionSettings.server_urls.llamacpp = c.url; $('#max_context_unlocked').prop('checked', c.unlocked).trigger('change'); $('#max_context').val(c.max).trigger('input'); globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.setUiSettings({ authorView: c.author }); } return true;
